listing.title: My First Valentine's Day Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Valentine's Day Pages – Heart, Teddy Bear, Cupcake & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of hearts!

Little hands color 30 Valentine's Day pictures, from a big smiling heart, heart balloons and a heart-shaped hot air balloon to a cupcake, a box of chocolates, a love letter and a teddy bear hugging a heart. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, lots of them with smiling faces, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Hearts everywhere: Heart, Heart Balloons, Heart Kite, Heart Glasses on a smiling sun, Heart Tree, Rainbow and a heart-shaped Hot Air Balloon
  • Yummy treats: Heart Cookie, Cupcake, Box of Chocolates, Candy Hearts, Lollipop, Heart Pizza and Milkshake
  • Cards and gifts: Valentine Card, Love Letter, Present, Flowers, Rose and Teddy Bear
  • Animal friends: Puppy, Kitty, Bunny, Panda, Mouse, Lovebirds, Penguins, Ladybug, Octopus and Elephant
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
